decisions.reason: A coupling protection cap is a simple accessory that fits squarely within the firm's trailer know-how and after-sales channels, so it can easily interpret results and refine it at low cost.
Box car trailers are core to the firm's existing production knowledge and are featured on the home page, so the firm can readily assimilate market feedback and improve the series.
A car transporter is related to the firm's trailer engineering but is a more specialised segment, so absorptive capacity is adequate though somewhat less certain.
Low-bed trailers build directly on the firm's established platform and production processes, and their home-page prominence signals strategic commitment.
High trailer covers are a close extension of existing trailer lines and accessories, so the firm can learn from early results and adapt them easily.
A second box car trailer series lies within the firm's core competence, though overlap with Product B slightly raises the chance of consolidation.
